request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere, not on signs, screens, clothes, bags, machines or vehicles. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

Only this one person is in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.

It is clearly daytime with soft natural light.

Image 1 shows Ana. Using the same woman (long dark wavy hair, light-olive skin, sage-green overshirt over a white top and jeans), create a NEW photograph in her bright living room with plain white walls and a light wooden floor. The camera is straight behind Ana at chest height and looks the same way she looks. Ana stands just left of the middle of the photo with her back to the camera, facing the blue bag: her feet, hips, chest, shoulders and head all point at it. We see only the back of her head and neck: no face, no eyes, no nose, no profile. A large RED canvas tote bag hangs from her left shoulder at her left side, close to the camera, and her left hand rests on it. Straight ahead of Ana, one BLUE canvas tote bag of the same shape and size sits alone on the seat of a light wooden chair against the far plain white wall, about four meters away, a little to the right of her head, whole, sharp and easy to see. Her right arm reaches forward and clearly DOWN toward the blue bag, about 30 degrees below level, the hand lower than her shoulder, and the index finger points directly at the blue bag; the arm, the finger and her head form one line toward it, nothing is between the finger and the blue bag, and the fingertip stays far from it. Nothing else is in the room: no other bags, furniture, pictures or objects.
